# cloider_bucket_regions (Data Source)

The regions a `cloider_bucket` can be created in.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "cloider_bucket_regions" "all" {}

resource "cloider_bucket" "assets" {
  name   = "acme-assets"
  region = data.cloider_bucket_regions.all.regions[0].code
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `regions` (Attributes List) The regions, the default one first. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--regions))

<a id="nestedatt--regions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `regions`

Read-Only:

- `code` (String) The code `cloider_bucket`'s `region` takes, such as `eu-central-2`.
- `endpoint` (String) The S3 endpoint of its buckets.
- `name` (String) The region's name.
